Automata.notes: Read from src/Automata at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Automata, which matches the code. The eight trigger outputs are given no family because what each carries depends on its own menu setting: a trigger in one mode and a slowly moving percentage voltage in the other. ConductorExternal.notes: Read from src/ConductorExternal at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Conductor - External. The wiki calls the menu item Clear mapping; the item prints Clear mappings (Widget.cpp). The CV 1 jack is given no family because what it wants depends on the mode knob: a level in Index, a trigger in Scroll and a pitch in Note Map. The Note Map quantisation is 24 steps per octave (ConductorExternal.cpp:286), which is quarter-tones rather than semitones. The module's own name in the browser is External MIDI controller expander for Conductor, though nothing about it is specific to MIDI.

lines: Expander that drives Conductor from a grid of eight pads, with pages so that more than eight patterns can be reached
Steps the page number down by one
Steps the page number up by one
Queues its pattern in Conductor, or takes it out of the queue if it was already queued; which pattern that is depends on the page
Note — the module has to be placed touching the right-hand side of Conductor or of another Conductor expander; anywhere else it does nothing
Note — the pad for the queued pattern blinks blue and the pad for the pattern now playing is lit red
Note — the upper display reads the page number and the lower one the pattern queued in Conductor
Note — the two page buttons have no hover text of their own; the panel marks them with a minus and a plus
Note — the module has no jacks at all; it reaches Conductor through the expander connection alone
ConductorGrid.notes: Read from src/ConductorGrid at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Conductor - Grid, which matches the code. The eight pads are configured as buttons named Pad 1 to Pad 8 (ConductorGrid.cpp:36); the two page buttons are added by the widget with no configButton call at all, so they have empty hover text. The module declares no inputs and no outputs, so there are no port props to give.
